understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate each grid level and complete all goal cells. A goal cell is completed by stepping onto it only when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required values; completing all goals advances to the next level, and finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs 1 stamina; if stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum, and losing all lives ends the game. Movement is constrained by walls, and the state provides blocked_directions that must never be chosen because blocked moves waste a turn and stamina without changing position. Special modifier tiles change the carried piece when stepped on: shape modifiers cycle shape 0–5 (wrapping), color modifiers cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation modifiers rotate 90° clockwise (0→90→180→270→0). A goal activates only when shape+color+rotation all match simultaneously; then stepping onto the activated goal completes it. Efficient routing is required to avoid wasted moves and stamina loss.
